title: The ball girl
summary: A ball girl throws you the ball quickly for a throw-in and you score from it. Their gaffer has a go at her on the touchline, and she's in tears. A season on, she's a bit taller and still holding a ball.

ends.title: Quick hands
ends.text: A ball girl gave you a quick throw and got told off for it. You went over. She's a ball girl every week now, and quick about it.

ends.title: Just a throw
ends.text: A ball girl threw you a quick one, you scored, and you never knew what happened to her after.

beats.title: The throw

event.title: The throw
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: Seventy-ninth minute. A ball girl, about eleven, gets you the ball quick for a throw. You take it fast, and you score from it. Their gaffer goes over and shouts at her in front of everyone. At full time she's crying on her stool.

say: {kidfan.name} is wiping her face on her bib. She sees you coming and sits up straight, like she's in trouble again.

boots.text: She takes them like they're hot. Her mum, in the front row, has her hand over her mouth.

word.text: She nods very hard. You fist-bump her. The crying stops.

tunnel.text: You go in. In the dressing room someone says the ball girl's still out there.

beats.hint: A ball girl has had a bad night

beats.title: The letter from her school

event.title: The letter from her school
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: A letter from a primary school two towns away. The ball girl's class wants to know if a throw-in is a skill or luck. They've drawn pictures.

say: One picture is of the girl with a very long arm.

replies.label: Go and do an assembly about throw-ins.

visit.text: Thirty kids throw beanbags at you in a hall. She throws hers quickest.

write.text: The teacher puts your letter up in the corridor.

bin.text: You let it go, and get on with your day.

beats.hint: The ball girl's school has written

beats.title: Quick hands

event.title: Quick hands
event.speaker: kidfan
setup: A season on, the same ground. The same ball girl, taller, on the same stool by the corner flag.
{if arc.deep=='visit'}She still talks about the beanbags.{/if}

choices.label: Give her a nod as you go past.

outcomes.text: She nods back. In the second half she throws you the ball before it's even stopped. Their gaffer glares. She doesn't care.
She doesn't look up. She gives you the ball slowly all night.

choices.label: Keep your eyes on the game.

outcomes.text: You don't see her. At full time she shouts your name. She's got your boots on, two sizes too big.
You don't see her. You don't think about the throw.

beats.hint: A season on, the same ground
